# `deselect_star`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reset the guider so that no guide star is selected or locked.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x74a40 (64-bit guider build); guider reset @0xea660 |

No parameters are read. Calls the guider reset (with its state-clearing option set), which clears the selected star and the guiding state. The reset descends into guider state and lock notification paths, so events may follow; which ones depend on the previous state and are unresolved. If the guider object does not exist the request fails with 300.

Side effects: Clears the selected guide star and guider state; may emit guider state or lock notifications.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"deselect_star"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 300 | No guider object exists | `internal error` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":121,"method":"deselect_star"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"deselect_star","result":0,"code":0,"id":121}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"deselect_star","error":"internal error","code":300,"id":122}
```
